properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 10 at 12:54PM CDT until October 12 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Aransas Islands, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands and
Calhoun Islands Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 1 AM CDT Monday.
For the High Rip Current Risk, through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Rip currents can sweep even
the most experienced swimmers away from shore into deeper
water. These rip currents can become life-threatening to
anyone entering the surf.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of eastern, northeast, and south central Nevada,
including the following areas, in eastern Nevada, White Pine. In
northeast Nevada, Ruby Mountains and East Humboldt Range in Elko,
South Central Elko and Southeastern Elko. In south central Nevada,
Northeastern Nye and Northwestern Nye.

* WHEN...From this evening through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers, creeks, streams,
and other low-lying and flood-prone locations. In addition, flash
flooding is possible over recently burned areas like the former
Ward Fire, Kearny Fire, Oxley Fire, Secret Pass Fire, Starr Valley
Fire, Jones Fire, and Egberts Fire. Other burn scar locations in
the watch area could also be affected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Deep moisture from decaying Hurricane Rachel is expected to move
northward, crossing into portions of east-central and eastern
Nevada late tonight through roughly Monday. This significant
moisture will interact with upper level low pressure to bring
widespread showers with isolated thunderstorms to the watch area.
Moderate to locally heavy rain will cause excessive runoff and
may result in rock, mud, and debris flows in and near former fire
burned areas, steep terrain, and poorly drained urban areas.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations. In
addition, flash flooding is possible over recently burned areas
like the former Oxley Fire, Antelope Fire, California Creek Fire,
and Master Fire. Other burn scar locations in the watch area could
also be affected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Deep moisture from decaying Hurricane Rachel is expected to move
northward, crossing into portions of east-central and eastern
Nevada late tonight through roughly Monday. This significant
moisture will interact with upper level low pressure to bring
widespread showers with isolated thunderstorms to the watch area.
Moderate to locally heavy rain will cause excessive runoff and
may result in rock, mud, and debris flows in and near former fire
burned areas, steep terrain, and poorly drained urban areas.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 10 at 1:48PM EDT until October 12 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Greenville-Spartanburg SC
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Greenville-Spartanburg has issued
a Flood Warning for the following rivers in North Carolina...

(English) Broad River At above Sandy Run Ck, 3 SSW Boiling Springs
affecting Cleveland County.

.Heavy tropical showers will continue to overspread the Broad River
basin through tonight with 3 to 4 inches accumulating with locally as
much as 8 inches possible in favored locales and higher elevations.
Confidence has increased that flooding along the Broad River will
develop this weekend.  Interests all along the Broad River, even as
far upstream as Bat Cave are urged to monitor river levels and take
appropriate action as needed.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...(English) Broad River at above Sandy Run Ck, 3 SSW Boiling
Springs.

* WHEN...From Sunday night to Monday morning.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1:15 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 2.5 feet and rising.  A
crest exceeding 12.0 feet is likely to occur on Sunday with the
river reaching 14.0 a probable worst case scenario.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
Monday morning to a crest of 13.2 feet Monday morning. It will
then fall below flood stage late Monday morning.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.2
feet on 09/26/1929.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

flood impacts, flood history, FEMA Flood Hazard Layers, and more,

properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 10 at 1:30PM EDT until October 11 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Blacksburg VA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of North Carolina, including the following areas,
Alleghany NC, Ashe, Surry, Watauga and Wilkes and southwest
Virginia, including the following areas, Carroll, Floyd, Grayson
and Patrick.

* WHEN...Through Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Low-water crossings
may be flooded. Storm drains and ditches may become clogged with
debris. Extensive street flooding and flooding of creeks and rivers
are possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The remnants of Isaias will bring widespread rainfall along the
crest of the southern Blue Ridge from Floyd County, Virginia to
Watauga county, North Carolina. Widespread rainfall totals of 2-4
inches with locally higher totals in the 5-6 range will be
possible, especially for areas like Meadows of Dan, Boone, and
Blowing Rock. These higher totals may lead to isolated instances
of landslides along slopes that have been modified by humans like
embankments or cut slopes. These areas may also see increased
rises on local streamflows that may lead to flooding across
low-water crossings.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.
